description: Shows the agent wallet address, whether the user has paused spending, its NGT balance on Base, the per-call cap, the session budget left, and about how many calls the balance covers at the 0.001 NGT reference price. If the user turned USDC on, also its USDC balance, cap and budget left. Spends nothing. If no wallet is set up, says how to set one up.
name: ngt_wallet_status
title: NGT Wallet Status
